faculty.name: Ronald Walter Greene
faculty.summary: Studies how institutions regulate debate, discussion, and persuasion to shape democratic decision making, using rhetorical, argumentation, and cultural theory.
faculty.summary_zh: 从修辞、论辩与文化理论出发，研究机构如何规制辩论、讨论与说服以影响民主决策。

faculty.name: Atilla Hallsby
faculty.summary: Examines how rhetoric shapes public perceptions of secrecy, transparency, surveillance, and AI in U.S. political culture through rhetorical criticism and critical theory.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用修辞批评与批判理论，研究修辞如何塑造美国政治文化中公众对秘密、透明、监控与人工智能的认知。

faculty.name: Elaine Hsieh
faculty.summary: Studies interpersonal and intercultural communication in health care, including interpreter-mediated medical interactions, cultural frameworks of health, and bioethics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究医疗情境中的人际与跨文化传播，包括口译员介入的医患互动、健康的文化框架以及生命伦理。

faculty.name: Susanne M. Jones
faculty.summary: Studies supportive communication, nonverbal behavior, and mindfulness in emotion regulation using lab experiments with recorded and coded conversations.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过实验室实验并对录制的对话进行编码分析，研究支持性传播、非语言行为以及正念在情绪调节中的作用。

faculty.name: Zornitsa Keremidchieva
faculty.summary: Studies feminist, institutional, and congressional rhetoric, immigration and citizenship, and democratic governance through rhetorical and historical analysis of policy discourse.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过对政策话语的修辞与历史分析，研究女性主义修辞、制度与国会修辞、移民与公民身份以及民主治理。

faculty.name: Ascan F. Koerner
faculty.summary: Studies family and marital communication and the cognitive bases of relationships, including relational schemas, message production, and persuasion.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究家庭与婚姻传播以及人际关系的认知基础，包括关系图式、讯息生产与说服。

faculty.name: Kate Lockwood Harris
faculty.summary: Studies how violence and communication relate, especially organizational responses to sexual assault and Title IX, using feminist, intersectional, and qualitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用女性主义、交叉性与质性方法，研究暴力与传播的关系，尤其是组织对性侵害的回应与美国《第九条》。

faculty.name: Laurie Ouellette
faculty.summary: Studies how popular media such as reality TV, lifestyle media, and influencers govern bodies, subjectivities, and citizenship, using critical cultural and historical analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用批判文化与历史分析，研究真人秀、生活方式媒体和网红等流行媒介如何治理身体、主体性与公民身份。

faculty.name: Gilbert B. Rodman
faculty.summary: Studies critical media and cultural studies, popular culture, communication technologies, and the politics of race, including the history of race and copyright in the US.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究批判媒介与文化研究、流行文化、传播技术与种族政治，包括美国种族与版权的历史。

faculty.name: Mary Douglas Vavrus
faculty.summary: Studies news representations of gender, postfeminism, political women, and the links between media and militarism through feminist and political-economic critique.
faculty.summary_zh: 从女性主义与政治经济学批判视角，研究新闻中的性别再现、后女性主义、女性政治人物以及媒介与军事主义的关联。

faculty.name: Emily Winderman
faculty.summary: Studies the rhetoric of health and medicine, especially reproductive health, abortion, and infectious disease, using archival rhetorical history, feminist and affect theory.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用档案修辞史、女性主义与情感理论，研究健康与医学修辞，尤其是生殖健康、堕胎与传染病话语。

faculty.name: Deborah Yoon
faculty.summary: Studies identity uncertainty and information management in nontraditional families, such as adoptees seeking genetic family health history, and intercultural identity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非传统家庭中的身份不确定性与信息管理，例如寻求遗传家族健康史的被收养者，以及跨文化身份经验。

faculty.name: Colin Agur
faculty.summary: Studies mobile communication, infrastructures, platforms, and digital economies as systems that organize social and political life, drawing on media history and political economy.
faculty.summary_zh: 借助媒介史与政治经济学，研究移动传播、基础设施、平台与数字经济如何组织社会与政治生活。

faculty.name: Sid Bedingfield
faculty.summary: Studies journalism's role in democracy during political change, especially the press, civil rights, and white supremacy in the US South, using historical archival research.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用历史档案研究，考察政治变革时期新闻业在民主中的作用，尤其是美国南方的报业、民权运动与白人至上主义。

faculty.name: Valérie Bélair-Gagnon
faculty.summary: Studies how media management and journalism shape innovation, labor, and well-being in newsrooms, using qualitative and hybrid methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用质性与混合方法，研究媒介管理与新闻业如何影响新闻编辑室中的创新、劳动与从业者福祉。

faculty.name: Matt Carlson
faculty.summary: Studies how actors compete to define journalism, its boundaries and norms, developing concepts like journalistic authority, metajournalistic discourse, and boundary work.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究不同行动者如何争夺对新闻业及其边界与规范的定义，发展了新闻权威、元新闻话语与边界工作等概念。

faculty.name: Elisia Cohen
faculty.summary: Studies health communication and multilevel community interventions to reduce health and cancer disparities through community-engaged research.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过社区参与式研究，探讨健康传播及多层次社区干预如何减少健康与癌症差异。

faculty.name: Nick Hagar
faculty.summary: Studies how AI is changing journalism and public information, including AI design, governance, and newsroom adoption, using computational methods and tool building.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用计算方法与工具开发，研究人工智能如何改变新闻业与公共信息，包括AI系统设计、治理及新闻机构的采纳。

faculty.name: Jisu Huh
faculty.summary: Studies advertising effects and its role in society, including computational and AI advertising, influencer marketing, consumer trust, and DTC pharmaceutical advertising.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究广告的效果及其社会角色，包括计算广告与AI广告、网红营销、消费者信任以及直接面向消费者的药品广告。

faculty.name: Sherri Jean Katz
faculty.summary: Tests health messages and packaging features to prevent youth uptake of tobacco, nicotine, and THC products, drawing on construal level and reactance theory.
faculty.summary_zh: 借助解释水平理论与心理抗拒理论，检验健康讯息与产品包装特征对预防青少年使用烟草、尼古丁与THC产品的作用。

faculty.name: Jeff Kosseff
faculty.summary: Studies First Amendment law, free speech online, Section 230, anonymous and false speech, and cybersecurity law through legal and historical analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过法律与历史分析，研究美国第一修正案、网络言论自由、第230条款、匿名与虚假言论以及网络安全法。

faculty.name: María Elizabeth Len-Ríos
faculty.summary: Studies public relations, health communication, and diversity, equity, and inclusion, including culture as a social determinant of health and journalistic norms around race.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究公共关系、健康传播与多元、公平和包容，包括文化作为健康的社会决定因素以及新闻规范与种族不平等。

faculty.name: Rebekah Nagler
faculty.summary: Studies effects of routine exposure to conflicting and controversial health information in the media, and health equity, including population-based survey research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究日常接触媒体中相互矛盾、具争议的健康信息所产生的效果以及健康公平，包括基于人口样本的调查研究。

faculty.name: Amy O'Connor
faculty.summary: Studies corporate social responsibility communication and stakeholder expectations of corporations, including a multi-year ethnography of Minnesota mining companies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究企业社会责任传播与利益相关者对企业的期待，包括对明尼苏达北部矿业公司的多年民族志研究。

faculty.name: Haseon Park
faculty.summary: Studies trust and consumer-brand relationships in emergent media and computational advertising, including influencer marketing and social listening data.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究新兴媒体中的信任与消费者-品牌关系以及计算广告，包括网红营销与社交聆听数据。

faculty.name: Adam Saffer
faculty.summary: Studies how individuals, groups, and organizations such as NGOs and agencies form and use communication networks, using network analysis of primary relational data.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用基于一手关系数据的网络分析，研究个人、群体以及非政府组织和政府机构等组织如何建立并运用传播网络。

faculty.name: Claire M. Segijn
faculty.summary: Studies intended and unintended effects of digital advertising, including media multitasking, synced and personalized ads, privacy concerns, and visual attention measured through eye tracking.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究数字广告的预期与非预期效果，包括媒体多任务、同步与个性化广告、隐私担忧，以及借助眼动追踪测量的视觉注意。

faculty.name: Erich Sommerfeldt
faculty.summary: Studies how public relations and public diplomacy contribute to social change and relationship building in developing, crisis-prone, and post-conflict societies, including network approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究公共关系与公共外交如何在发展中国家及危机频发、冲突后社会中促进社会变革与关系重建，并采用网络分析视角。

faculty.name: Christopher Terry
faculty.summary: Studies media law and regulation, including media ownership, political advertising rules, copyright and fair use, internet and broadband policy, through legal and regulatory analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 通过法律与规制分析，研究媒介法与规制，包括媒体所有权、政治广告规则、版权与合理使用以及互联网与宽带政策。

faculty.name: Benjamin Toff
faculty.summary: Studies news audiences, news avoidance, trust in news, political engagement, and the role of opinion polls in coverage of American politics, including multi-country research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究新闻受众、新闻回避、新闻信任、政治参与以及民调在美国政治报道中的作用，包括多国比较研究。

faculty.name: Carolina Velloso
faculty.summary: Studies journalism and identity, ethics, and practice from historical and contemporary lenses, with attention to gender, race, and sports journalism.
faculty.summary_zh: 从历史与当代视角研究新闻业与身份、伦理及实践，关注性别、种族与体育新闻。

faculty.name: Emily Vraga
faculty.summary: Studies how people respond to health, science, and political information online, especially correcting misinformation on social media, using experiments, surveys, content analysis, and interviews.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用实验、调查、内容分析与访谈，研究人们如何回应网络上的健康、科学与政治信息，尤其是社交媒体上的虚假信息纠正。

faculty.name: Michelle Wood
faculty.summary: Studies strategic communication with an emphasis on persuasion theory, inoculation and resistance to influence, and consumer processing of media messages.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究战略传播，重点关注说服理论、免疫理论与抗拒影响，以及消费者对媒介讯息的加工。

faculty.name: Marco Yzer
faculty.summary: Studies how people use health information in behavioral decisions, focusing on mental health communication and message design grounded in reasoned action theory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何在健康行为决策中使用健康信息，聚焦心理健康传播及基于理性行为理论的讯息设计。

faculty.name: Alvin Zhou
faculty.summary: Studies how generative AI reshapes advantages among messages, organizations, and publics in strategic communication, using computational methods and causal inference.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用计算方法与因果推断，研究生成式AI如何在战略传播中重塑讯息、组织与公众之间的优势分配。
